posts.subject: Chat spam/ addition to rules
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dear Dream Community,


I have came across today with @Doo Doo on a knife server to a very weird chat spam it's when someone uses !ff in console and it says in chat like spamming it fast " Friendly Fire is Disabled" I think cool idea would be to block users from using this command so they don't get to spam it and people get less annoyed, moving onto the rules addition I know @Hypnoxas mentions it to people on the bhop server but I think it would be a good idea to add into the rules that shooting at spawn is not allowed as it's more difficult to bhop when someone is shooting a gun at you like a Negev and final suggestion is to add into rules that you're not allowed to do calladmin abuse I know it's obvious but it's better when it's in rules as later people think that it's not in the rules so they can spam it and when they get banned they will protest and say it's not in the "rules"


Kind Regards


Michal "OxygeN" J.

Yeah, I agree with you.
Spawn killer are very Irritating and the Game fun goes away.
It would be very nice if There would be a rule against spawn killing.


Best whishes
your JP
